desc: Derive a matrix/DP formulation of the total weighted monotone-path sum that is suitable for composing regions and point updates.
Fix and sample-test localized batching: retain the contribution of paths avoiding the batch rectangle and correct local boundary initialization.

Derive an explicit worst-case-efficient dynamic representation for the monotone-grid path partition function under point updates along the connected walk, preferably via a planar determinant/augmented inverse formulation that supports zero weights; give concrete update/query operations and proved complexity bounds.
Investigate whether weighted monotone-grid transfer matrices admit a semiseparable representation stable under point updates and composition.
Prove correctness of the selected data structure, including endpoint updates and repeated updates to a cell.
Produce a constraint-compliant Python implementation and complexity analysis.
